score_policy: Do not publish a combined score when growth/full-run evidence is absent. Choose by paired measured outcomes and hard gates, not a score target.

definitions.effective_damage: Sum actual HP lost from real enemy presentation hurt events; excludes overkill; includes legitimate echoes/explosions.
definitions.nominal_damage: Accepted collision requested damage; may include overkill.
definitions.cooldown_wait: Seconds with living threats and formal launch unavailable, while player is alive.
definitions.corner_time: Low velocity (<80) in70px boundary band while targets remain; a stall proxy, not proof of a softlock.
definitions.mechanism_hp: All HP lost across20s, including moving hazards after target clear; inspect full runs before difficulty claims.
definitions.reversal_time: Delay after fixed2.35s reverse-intent time until velocity.x<-50; includes input/cooldown response.
definitions.censored: Fixture or run timed out; never counted as a victory.
definitions.first_effective_damage: First actual enemy HP loss, excluding overkill; absent event is duration20 censored, never instant success.

selection.note: Separate direct-launch factor: require both 5% paired mean clear and 5% first actual HP damage improvement. Preserve HP, worst-case, physics and holdout/normal-route gates. No retroactive relaxation of control/cooldown/transfer groups.
